subject: Atrialix dedicated pool runway gating & provisional hold request
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-15T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Atrialix — late-stage runway check / soft-hold request

Team,

Atrialix (late-stage, execs + procurement engaged) asked yesterday if we can guarantee runway for a small dedicated pool tied to their production rollout. High level ask: 8 GPU-equivalent capacity for an initial 3-month window starting ~2028-01-16, with the option to scale. They want a formal soft/standby hold while procurement finishes commercial and security review.

Can you confirm inventory and whether we can place a provisional hold (no charges yet) for that window? Key constraints:
- Preferred hw: H100 or A100-equivalent (high-throughput)
- Region: us-east (low-latency to their infra)
- Start target: 2028-01-16 (flexible +/- 7d)
- Duration: 3 months initial, followed by conversion to reserved capacity if the deal closes

Please call out:
1) Exact node SKU we can commit (count + model)
2) Any dependencies (maintenance, migrations) that would block a hold
3) A short fallback plan (if H100 unavailable, fallback to A100-40GB + perf caveat)

I attached a quick compute estimate they sent (I trimmed PII) — we should update the numbers if needed. We may need a one-line note for Legal/Finance to include in the commercial term that this is a non-binding provisional hold.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachment: atrialix_compute_estimate.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-15T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Atrialix — late-stage runway check / soft-hold request

Ben —

Quick inventory readout after checking east/us pool and reserved buffers:
- Can provision a provisional hold equivalent to: 8x A100-80GB (preferred) OR 6x H100 (higher single-token throughput) across two racks.
- If customer requires strict parity on H100/PCIe counts, we can map 6x H100 + 2x A100 as a hybrid to hit throughput targets; will need to pin to specific nodes.
- Maintenance windows: the earliest scheduled maintenance in that cluster is 2028-01-22 (1–3 hour patch), which is within their desired window; we can commit to avoiding critical updates during the first 7 days of the hold at ops level (we'll reserve a blackout).

Action items / caveats:
- To place a soft hold we need a PO or a written request from customer procurement indicating desire for provisional hold term and tentative start. This is non-billable; ops will not allocate physical isolation until conversion.
- Fallback: if H100 supply shifts, we'll offer A100-80GB with expected ~10–18% higher tail latency on certain generation models. We should flag this in the SOW.
- Ops needs final node pinning 21 days before start date to perform warm-up and KV cache pre-population.

I'll prepare a short note for Legal stating: "Provisional Hold: Redwood will reserve the identified nodes for Atrialix for the requested window. Reservation is non-binding and subject to final commercial agreement; Redwood will not invoice during provisional hold. Conversion to reserved capacity will require signed order and may incur backfill/activation fees if capacity was reallocated in the interim."

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Alex Morris <alex.morris@atrialix.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@atrialix.com
Date: 2027-11-17T10:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Atrialix — late-stage runway check / soft-hold request

Thanks, Ben & team — appreciate the quick follow.

We can provide a written request from procurement to initiate a provisional hold; attached is our anticipated SOW window (internal). A few asks from our side before we formalize that note:
- Can Redwood confirm the soft-hold will be non-billable and that nodes will not be physically isolated until conversion? (Karthik's note is helpful but we need explicit language for our procurement team.)
- Ballpark pricing for conversion (month-to-month reserved) — we only need a headline range to decide on internal budget sign-off.
- A single point of contact on your side for security questionnaire queries (we may hit you with SOC2 / data retention questions this week).

Target start remains ~2028-01-16. Procurement will send the provisional-hold request today (procurement@atrialix.com). Can you confirm the requested blackout for the first week and the 21-day pinning requirement?

—Alex
Alex Morris
Head of Platform, Atrialix
alex.morris@atrialix.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morris <alex.morris@atrialix.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-18T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Atrialix — late-stage runway check / soft-hold request

Alex — thanks for the note and for looping procurement. Confirming:

- Redwood will accept a written provisional-hold request from procurement. Ops will log a non-billable soft hold for the requested window once we receive that note.
- Soft-hold semantics: non-billable, non-isolating. Physical node allocation and hard isolation only occur after conversion (signed order / PO / SOW).
- Blackout: ops confirms we can schedule no major maintenance in the first 7 days of the window; Karthik also noted the 21-day node pinning requirement for pre-warm operations.
- Pricing: ballpark range for conversion to a dedicated reserved pool (per month) is attached in the estimate; Laura, can you please share an abbreviated pricing summary for procurement to use for internal approval?

Laura — can you draft a one-paragraph legal-friendly line confirming the provisional hold is non-binding and that conversion requires signed commercial terms? I'll forward that to Alex+procurement. I've attached an updated terms draft (dedicated_terms_draft_v3.pdf) and our compute estimate.

Next steps:
- Procurement sends provisional-hold request to procurement@redwood.com (we'll use that as trigger).
- Laura to prepare 1-paragraph for procurement/legal and a 1-sheet pricing summary.
- Ops (Karthik) to put the soft hold in the inventory system and note the pin-window requirement.

Ben
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
Attachments: dedicated_terms_draft_v3.pdf, atrialix_compute_estimate.xlsx
